#film-club #documentary

Shortlist for the documentary month, June 2025, after Ishbel said the club "only likes men in hats shooting each other". Fair. Ranked by how much I want them: "Man with a Movie Camera" (Dziga Vertov, 1929, 68 min, play it with the Cinematic Orchestra score from 2002), "Grey Gardens" (Maysles brothers, 1975, 94 min), "Stop Making Sense" (Jonathan Demme, 1984, 88 min, the 2023 4K restoration, I'll bring my own speakers), "Hoop Dreams" (Steve James, 1994, 170 min, too long for a Thursday, maybe a Sunday), "Honeyland" (2019, 89 min, the beekeeper in North Macedonia, someone in the club keeps bees and will love it, see [[Hive inspection checklist]]), and "The Act of Killing" (Joshua Oppenheimer, 2012, 159 min) which will empty the room, and should. Licence quotes from Filmbank came to £340 for four of them, ref FB-63390. Editing in "Man with a Movie Camera" deserves its own talk, notes in [[Editing rhythm]].
